q1: SELECT DISTINCT VIEWER_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS GROUP BY VIEW_DATE, VIEWER_ID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ARTICLE_ID) > 1 ORDER BY ID
q2: SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM ( SELECT VIEW_DATE, VIEWER_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ARTICLE_ID) > 1 ) F ORDER BY 1
